installation_steps.comment: extra deps from setup.py not in requirements.txt

post_install_hooks.cmd: if [ -f /workspace/isaacgym/python/setup.py ]; then cd /workspace/isaacgym/python && uv pip install -e .; else echo 'WARN: isaacgym not mounted at /workspace/isaacgym; skipping isaacgym install'; fi

runtime_mounts.evidence: Once Isaac Gym is installed and samples work within your current python environment, install this repo: pip install -e .

readme_quotes: Details regarding installation of IsaacGym can be found here. We currently support the Preview Release 3/4 version of IsaacGym.
Once Isaac Gym is installed and samples work within your current python environment, install this repo: pip install -e .
requirements.txt: gym, torch==1.8.1, matplotlib==3.5.1, tqdm, ipdb
setup.py INSTALL_REQUIRES: gym, matplotlib==3.5.1, tqdm, ipdb, numpy==1.23.0, rl-games==1.5.2
ambiguities: requirements.txt pins torch==1.8.1; kept as-is since IsaacGym Preview 4 was validated with this version
needs_setuptools_pin quirk active due to rl-games==1.5.2 using pkg_resources; auto-injected setuptools>=62.3,<81
isaacgym is closed-source and cannot be cloned at build time; installed via post_install_hook on first container start after sibling mount at /workspace/isaacgym
